records: Circle Q2 2026 Form 10-Q's 19.5% daily weighted-average USDC-on-platform percentage and $12.442B end balance are Circle's own platform metrics, not Coinbase's. The filing's note 1579 defines Circle's platform as Circle Mint accounts, corporate-held USDC and non-custodial wallets offered through Circle. A prior ledger note/snapshot misattributed these metrics to Coinbase; this correction supersedes that wording without rewriting historical records.

Coinbase's Q3 2026 average USDC held in Coinbase products is $22B, up 49% year over year, per its October 29 earnings release. This is a separate company-defined measure and cannot be directly reconciled to Circle's Q2 $12.442B Circle-platform end balance or 19.5% Circle-platform share without aligned scope and dates. Coinbase's statement that it captured approximately 50% of all USDC economics is a company claim, not independently verified here.

Circle SBI Japan K.K. / SBI Circle Holdings is a 50/50 Circle-SBI JV. Circle's Q2 2026 SEC filing says Circle consolidates it as a VIE despite equal equity and reports no significant operating results through June 30, 2026. The November 4, 2026 Q3 results are needed before asserting current operating scale or Japanese USDC balances attributable to the JV.

SBI's approximately 9% Ripple shareholding is a historical disclosure as of June 2025, not a verified October 2026 cap table. SBI Group's current profile confirms 60% of SBI Ripple Asia voting rights as of March 31, 2026; the 40% Ripple share is supported by a February 2025 SBI presentation but has not been independently reverified as current.

Binance's $100M Circle investment and five-year USDC promotion arrangement are confirmed by Circle's SEC 8-K. The monthly incentive is tied to USDC held through Circle's Modular Smart Contract Wallet infrastructure, not necessarily every USDC balance on Binance. Binance retains stockholder voting rights but agreed to transfer/hedging restrictions for up to two years; no board seat or control right is established by the filing.

Circle's native USDC and Ripple's native RLUSD on XRPL, together with SBI and Coinbase relationships to both issuers, do not establish a direct Circle-Ripple partnership, a common reserve/collateral pool, or incremental native XRP demand. Route-level transactions and XRP bridge/collateral usage remain unmeasured.
